Hi Marta,

Thanks again for signing PO PB-4491 — really appreciate the quick turnaround. Finance flagged two items on our side before we can clear payment:

- Palmer Bio appears to have a vendor debit-block in your procurement system that rejects virtual-card payments for new vendors.
- We also saw mention of potential UK withholding on this line item and want to make sure collection aligns with your AP rules.

Attached: invoice_PB-4491_202609.pdf (PDF) and PO_PB-4491_signed.docx (DOCX).

Options from our side that would keep funds moving quickly:
1) If AP can accept a virtual card (single charge) please confirm and we will issue immediately.
2) If virtual card is blocked, we can do a one-off wire for the full amount. If you choose wire we need your bank remittance details and the AP contact that will upload the proof.
3) If withholding applies and you need net payment, we can split: wire the withheld portion now and charge the remainder to a virtual card once cleared.

Could you confirm which path you prefer and, if wire, send the exact bank coordinates (IBAN, BIC, account name) and any payment reference you need? Ben (cc'd) is on the account and can assist with timing.

We'd like to close this by the end of the week if possible — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow (Wed)?

Best,

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — we do have the signed PO and invoice in our queue. Quick update from AP: because of a recent vendor-debit policy we introduced, new suppliers in the life-sciences category are blocked from virtual-card pay unless they are whitelisted. Whitelisting requires a short compliance review (2–3 business days).

Separately, our tax team flagged that this payment is subject to UK withholding. I attached the withholding certificate we require back from vendors for our gross-to-net processing. If you can confirm whether Redwood will issue gross (with us withholding) or net (you remit the withheld amount separately) that determines our path.

Attached: uk_withholding_certificate.pdf (PDF).

Two paths from our side:
- If Redwood supplies the withholding paperwork and agrees to net remittance for the withheld portion (we will pay you net), we can process the net payment via wire immediately once we have your bank details.
- If you prefer gross payment from Palmer Bio, we will need to collect the withholding from you directly (we do not gross-up) and that will introduce an extra step on our end.

AP can accept a wire today if we have IBAN/BIC and a contact email for remittance upload. Whitelist for virtual card is possible but slower.

Thanks for the clear options.

—Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Palmer Bio

Marta — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the certificate. Quick response to your two points:

1) Withholding approach: Redwood can accept being paid net (Palmer withholds the tax) — in that case we will invoice for the gross amount and you will remit net, and we will record the withholding on our side. If you pay net, please confirm you will also upload the withholding proof to the AP portal so we can reconcile.

2) Payment method: to avoid the whitelist delay we propose a split-path that should minimize friction:
   • Immediate wire for the withheld portion (so your AP keeps its standard gross->net flow).
   • Virtual card for the remaining balance once your system allows the merchant (or as soon as your whitelist completes).

If AP prefers a single step instead, we can do a one-off wire for the full gross amount and Redwood will provide a remittance stub showing the withholding once your tax team confirms amounts. Either way we can accept wire today if you provide: IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, account name, and a remittance email.

Attached I'm including a small bank stub file (bank_stub_redwood_wire.txt) with our wire beneficiary reference and accounting note you can paste into your payment portal. If you confirm the split path we'll issue the wire for the withholding slice first thing tomorrow and submit the card charge for the remaining balance as soon as you're able.

Suggested timeline:
- Today: you confirm wire details and whether AP will upload withholding PDF to portal.
- Tomorrow: Redwood initiates withheld-portion wire (if confirmed).
- Within 3 business days: virtual-card payment for remaining balance or full-wire if you prefer single payment.

Ben is included here to assist with timing or to provide an expedited whitelist contact if that helps.

Appreciate the quick turn — let us know preference.

Best,
